sourceReview.geometry: Eight distinct3D vertices per cube, six faces, all three position/scale coordinates applied independently, camera yaw/pitch rotates3Dcoordinates, positive depth affects perspective factor. Far-to-near face painting and polygon hit testing use projected coordinates.
sourceReview.controls: Scene list and mesh pick select object identity; transforms update only selected object; pointer/keyboard orbit, wheel/button zoom, delete/empty/maxscene controls checked. Selection button focus preserved during list refresh.
sourceReview.manualVisualReview: Desktop1280/mobile390 full-page screenshots inspected; initialcube has visible three-dimensional faces; controls fit width and remain reachable with ordinary vertical scrolling.
limitations: Small cube-only modelling prototype, not mesh editing or CAD.
Painter-style face sorting is approximate for intersecting geometry.
Scene is ephemeral and resets after refresh; no persistence/export.
A causal browser result alone does not establish3Dmath; source review here is separate.

provenance: Engineer-authored reference. This page and its acceptance tests were not supplied to ongoing model tasks, used as training examples or counted as generated-model success. No GitHub writes/deployment.
